entries.description:

entries.data_nature: StormSpec scenario inputs constructed by GridStorm from observed stress days (analogue mapping, not a real system state)
entries.description:
Historical-analogue scenarios: the German highest-load day, the winter Dunkelflaute day and the combined high-load / low-renewable day (detected in OPSD 2015–2020) mapped onto the 24 snapshots of scigrid-de: hourly demand from the CC BY 4.0 load forecast, one MODELED daily availability multiplier per renewable carrier. The mapping and every result are **modeled** (DC LOPF, 2011 topology), not a reconstruction of the day.

Precomputed results (`data/observed/analogue-results.json`):

| Scenario | Day (UTC) | Unserved energy (MWh) | Peak shed (MW) | Shed hours |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|
| baseline (network day, no events) | 2011-01-01 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| `observed-dunkelflaute-2015-01-20` | 2015-01-20 | 2,721 | 230 | 17 |
| `observed-high-load-low-res-2017-01-24` | 2017-01-24 | 4,731 | 346 | 20 |
| `observed-peak-load-2017-12-13` | 2017-12-13 | 4,429 | 335 | 19 |

entries.data_nature: GridStorm-derived scenario parameters (MODELED mapping of a CC BY 4.0 forecast onto a network day)
entries.description:
For each observed stress day d with reference day r (nearest complete 1 January), `m_h = (F(d,h) / mean F(r)) / (L_net(h) / mean L_net)`, where F is the ENTSO-E day-ahead load forecast and L_net the scigrid-de network load; rounded to 4 decimals (docs/research/observed-analogue-scenarios.md §3).

**Time axis**: the `utc` timestamps are the SciGRID-DE **model snapshot hours** (2011-01-01 h:00 UTC) each multiplier is applied to, **not observation times**: hour h of the stress day (UTC) maps to model snapshot h. Each column is the hour-of-day profile of one stress day (2015-01-20, 2017-01-24, 2017-12-13). The renewable daily multipliers of the same file derive from non-open actual-generation data and are not published as series here.

entries.data_nature: TSO day-ahead total load forecast (ENTSO-E Art. 6.1.b), not measured load
entries.description:
Day-ahead forecast of the total load per market time unit for Germany (Reg. (EU) 543/2013 Art. 6.1.b) as published on the ENTSO-E Transparency Platform and packaged by Open Power System Data (time series 2020-10-06, column `DE_load_forecast_entsoe_transparency`).

This is the TSOs' forecast, **not measured load**. It is the only OPSD load column on ENTSO-E's free re-use list (item #1, CC BY 4.0); actual load, actual generation and capacities are not published here. Values are unchanged; missing hours stay empty. It is the demand input of the observed-analogue scenarios.
